problems.explain: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 for every θ. (The squares add to 1 whatever θ is; they do not add to 2.) So 1.

prompt.v: Simplify: sin²θ − 1

problems.text: trig simplify: sin(t)^2 - 1; options a: -1 | b: cos(t)^2 | c: tan(t)^2 | d: -cos(t)^2
problems.explain: sin²θ = 1 − cos²θ, so sin²θ − 1 = −cos²θ. (The order matters: sin²θ − 1 is the negative of 1 − sin²θ.) So −cos²θ.

prompt.v: Simplify: tan(−θ) cot θ

problems.text: trig simplify: tan(-t)*cot(t); options a: cos(t) | b: -1 | c: 1 | d: -cos(t)
problems.explain: tan(−θ) = −tan θ, and tan θ cot θ = 1: tan(−θ) cot θ = −1. (Tangent is odd, so the product is −1.) So −1.

problems.explain: Tangent is odd: tan(−θ) = −sin θ/cos θ = −tan θ. (An odd over an even is odd.) So −tan θ.
